extensions.name: OfficeCLI
extensions.description: Rel.AI integration for OfficeCLI to create, inspect, edit, validate, render, convert, and visually review DOCX/Word documents, XLSX/Excel spreadsheets or workbooks, and PPTX/PowerPoint presentations, slides, or decks.

extensions.name: DuckDB
extensions.description: Managed DuckDB CLI integration for fast local SQL analysis and transformation of CSV, Parquet, JSON, and other tabular data.

extensions.name: FFmpeg
extensions.description: FFmpeg and ffprobe integration for deterministic local video and audio inspection, conversion, trimming, compression, extraction, and transcoding.

extensions.name: ImageMagick
extensions.description: ImageMagick integration for deterministic local image inspection, resize, crop, conversion, optimization, compositing, and batch transformations.

extensions.name: PDF Tools
extensions.description: qpdf-based PDF structural tooling for checking, splitting, merging, selecting, rotating, linearizing, repairing, and inspecting PDF files.

extensions.name: ExifTool
extensions.description: ExifTool integration for reading, comparing, removing, copying, renaming from, and updating EXIF, GPS, XMP, IPTC, QuickTime, and other file metadata.

extensions.name: Pandoc
extensions.description: Pandoc integration for reliable local conversion among Markdown, HTML, DOCX, EPUB, LaTeX, reStructuredText, and other supported document formats.
